title: Initial velocity magnitude
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) must be expressed as v₀ = (√3/2)v.

title: Electric field magnitude
description: Essential: The final answer for part (2) must be expressed as E = (√3 mv²)/(4qL).

title: Plate separation distance
description: Essential: The final answer for part (3) must be expressed as d = (√3/6)L.

title: Horizontal motion analysis
description: Important: The solution must correctly apply constant horizontal velocity to relate L, v₀, and time.

title: Vertical motion analysis
description: Important: The solution must correctly analyze vertical acceleration from the electric force to find vertical displacement and final velocity.

title: Force and acceleration relation
description: Important: The solution must apply Newton's second law (F=ma) with the electric force (F=qE).

title: Velocity vector resolution
description: Important: The solution must resolve the final velocity into components, using the given 30° angle.

title: Sign error in acceleration
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the direction of acceleration (downward for a positive charge near the positive plate) is incorrect, leading to wrong signs in kinematic equations.

title: Unit consistency or omission
description: Optional: Award credit if the final answers are presented with correct or implied units (m/s, N/C, m).
